name.ja: 1/32 Imaginary Skeleton モササウルス

ja: “化石”という太古の記憶から“生”を想像するImaginary Skeletonシリーズより、本格骨格モデル第３弾として「モササウルス」が登場！
■全長約350mm。生物学に基づいた最新の学説からモササウルスの自然な動きをイメージし、その瞬間を切り取った固定骨格モデル。
■科学と造形美が融合した躍動感あるポージングと、全身に施されたディテール。組み立てながら恐竜の“生”を感じることができる。
■眼球を水圧から保護する強膜輪や獲物を飲み込みやすくする下顎内関節など、頭骨の複雑なディテールを忠実に再現。
■ヘビに近い仲間であることを示す2列に並んだ上顎の特殊な歯を再現。
■水圧対応と、軽快な動きの妥協点を極限まで模索したと思われる洗練された形状の肋骨や胸郭も再現。
■関節が多くなり、水を掻く動作がしなやかに行えるよう特化した鰭状の四肢のディテールを再現。
■組み立て時の目印として、似た形状が続く背骨中央には凹モールドを刻印。
■台座にはモササウルスと同時代、同地域に生息したアンモナイトやルディスト類（コップ型の特殊な二枚貝）など海洋生物を忠実に再現。
■爬虫類・恐竜研究家の富田京一氏監修の解説書小冊子が別冊で付属。
en: Total length is about 350mm. A fixed skeleton model that imagines the natural movement of mosasaurus from the latest theories based on biology and captures that moment.
A dynamic pose that combines science and plastic beauty, and details applied to the whole body. You can feel the "life" of dinosaurs while assembling them.
Faithfully reproduces the intricate details of the skull, such as the scleral ring that protects the eyeball from water pressure and the intramandibular joint that makes it easier to swallow prey.
Reproduce the special teeth of the upper jaw lined up in two rows to indicate that they are close to snakes.
The sophisticated shape of the ribs and rib cage, which seems to have sought a compromise between water pressure response and light movement to the extreme, is also reproduced.
More joints and reproduce the details of the fin-shaped limbs that are specialized for supple water scraping movements.
As a marker at the time of assembly, a concave mold is engraved in the center of the spine, which continues to have a similar shape.
The pedestal faithfully reproduces marine life such as ammonites and rudists (special cup-shaped bivalves) that lived in the same area at the same time as mosasaurus.
An explanatory booklet supervised by reptile and dinosaur researcher Kyoichi Tomita is attached as a separate volume.[Accessories]
